sentences: Traders moved $512 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-09-28, across 16.2 million individual trades. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 59% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 41%.
The most-traded market was "Will Flávio Bolsonaro win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?", pulling in $2 million of volume. Politics dominated the week's attention.
The usual pattern held: algorithmic traders made $201K (+126 bps on volume) while retail traders lost $33K (-347 bps).
